items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Well he was really my cousin

ctx.x: Well what kind of music did the brass band play? Did they play regular standard marches? Yeah. Hems or what?

They played marches, jazz numbers, I guess what they called you know at that time. They didn't understand, I don't guess they didn't understand much what they was doing anyway. But they wasn't up to like the fellas playing around here now, you know what I mean? Playing parades on the street. They had a band somewhere down on the other side of the river, I don't know who they was, from St. Sophie. They had a good band. They called him, you got a boy awake, they in the veteran hospital, call him Beam. Well he was…
